seo.seo_title: Websites for businesses in Boden | Norden Media UF
seo.seo_description: We build websites that get found on Google and win more customers, and handle domain, email and hosting. Fixed price, and you only pay when you are happy.

hero.t1: Local web agency in the north
hero.t4: We build websites that show who you are, get found on Google and bring in more customers. Clear, reliable and at a fixed price.

pay_when_you_are_happy.t11: You only pay when you are happy.

before_and_after.t21: Customers search. They find your competitor.
before_and_after.t22: Someone looks for what you do, but someone else shows up. The job goes to them.
before_and_after.t23: The website you would rather not show.
before_and_after.t24: It looks dated, struggles on mobile and you would rather point people to Facebook.
before_and_after.t26: People click in, look around and disappear. No calls, no bookings.
before_and_after.t28: Bookings and reminders are handled by hand, often in the evenings and at weekends.
before_and_after.t29: That is exactly what we fix.

who_we_are.t37: Norden Media UF is run by three students on the Technology Programme, specialising in information and media technology, at Björknäsgymnasiet in Boden. We do not stop until you are happy, and we are still here after launch.
who_we_are.t39_alt: The team behind Norden Media UF: three people in black t-shirts in front of a light wall

what_we_do.t42: From the first sketch to day-to-day operations. You get a finished solution.
what_we_do.t44: With booking and forms when needed.
what_we_do.t46: Business email on your own domain.
what_we_do.t48: On Google, in Maps and in AI answers.
what_we_do.t50: Confirmations and reminders to your customers.
what_we_do.t52: We keep everything running and up to date.

how_it_works.t56: You tell us what you need, we take care of the rest. It usually takes three to six weeks to launch.
how_it_works.t59: We get to know your business and what the website needs to do.
how_it_works.t61: You get a fixed price, a clear monthly fee and a short form about the content.
how_it_works.t63: We write the copy and build the website on a test address only you can see.
how_it_works.t65: You approve the website. We move your address and email and publish it.
how_it_works.t67: We keep the website running and help whenever something needs changing.

after_the_uf_year.t71: We plan to continue as a limited company after the UF year, with the same people and the same service.
after_the_uf_year.t72: The website and all its content belong to you.
after_the_uf_year.t73: If you want to run it yourselves, we hand everything over and show you how it works. We are happy to help with changes at an hourly rate.

we_also_stream_live.t77: We stream conferences, lectures and events with multiple cameras, clear sound and graphics, straight to your website and social media.
we_also_stream_live.t84_alt: Audience at an event at Boden Business Park, with a speaker on stage and a presentation on a large screen
we_also_stream_live.t86_alt: Video camera with a monitor filming a conversation on stage

faq.t90: Start-up cost from SEK 5,495 and a monthly fee from SEK 195. As a UF student company we do not charge VAT. Live streaming is quoted per event.
faq.t93: Once you have approved the finished website. The monthly fee starts at launch.
faq.t94: What happens when the UF year ends?
faq.t95: We plan to continue as a limited company with the same people. If you would rather run the website yourselves, we hand over all the material, and we are happy to help with changes at an hourly rate.
faq.t97: Usually three to six weeks, depending on the size of the website and how quickly we receive material.
faq.t99: Do we need to know anything about tech?
faq.t100: No. You tell us what you want and we handle the rest. Everything is explained in plain language.
faq.t101: We have no website at all. Is that a problem?
faq.t102: Not at all. We take care of everything, from domain and email to a finished website.
faq.t103: Can you take over our old website, domain and email?
faq.t104: Yes. We move everything so that you lose neither email nor your rankings on Google.
faq.t107: More people search using ChatGPT and Google's AI Overviews. We build the website so they understand what you offer and recommend you.
